title: HIT FLINCH
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 3, the animation pass. A hit used to show only as a red wash over the torso. Now a body that is hit flinches: the upper body is knocked away from the shot, the head snaps a little further, and it all eases back as the hit fades, while the legs stay planted. Pillagers flinch away from you; you flinch back from where you face. Drawn only: nothing about the fight changes.
now: Hits land: a body that is shot flinches away from the shot, head snapping back, then recovers.
